title: the proof of the pipeline measures the chain of the search and the whole source
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D0, the second repair): the pipeline of the diagrams works, but the check of wave 83 promised more than it proved, and the discriminator of the package of the waves 82 and 83 named two gaps (F12, F17).  The code of the pipeline is honest; the proof is not.  (1) **The chain of the search lives in one place — and the check measures it** (F12): the probe looked for any mention of the path of the chain, and a comment that names the file satisfied it; the check now looks for the **sourcing line** and for the **call** of the chain, and it searches every other file of `scripts/` for a **copy of the body** of the chain, name-blind.  (2) **The picture is drawn from the whole of its own source** (F17): the check looked for the label of the source in the picture, and a source cut in half still passed; the check now compares every label of the source — the states and the arrows — with the texts of the picture.  The claim `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes' keeps its id and is amended, not rewritten (the precedent is §16.28): the promise becomes exactly what the check proves.
objection: The claim is about a pipeline and not about a picture: the check draws its pictures in temporary trees, and the tree of the repository is never written.  The price of the two repairs is named.  (1) The search of a copy of the body of the chain is a search of a **text**: a copy that is rewritten and not copied escapes it, and the second probe — the steps of the search — catches such a copy only if the copy keeps both steps (`command -v' and the probe of `~/.nix-profile/bin').  The sourcing line is recognized as a line of the file, and a sourcing that hides the path behind a variable is not recognized as a reading of `scripts/lib/tools.sh' — the probe of the call and the runtime runs of the chain still hold there.  The scope of the search of a copy is `scripts/', as it was.  (2) The measurement of the whole source is a measurement of **presence**: every label of the source must be a text of the picture.  A picture drawn from a **superset** of the source is not seen by it, and a label that PlantUML rendered as two text elements would be reported as missing — that is not the case of the sources of the tree.  The wave touches the check and nothing else: the pipeline, the skins and the site are untouched, and the tree of the diagrams has one diagram more since the wave 84.
refuted_by: a step of the chain of the search does not work alone, or the chain of the search is copied in a second place, or the pipeline does not read the chain from the place where it lives, or the pipeline renders one theme only, or a diagram of the tree is not drawn, or a picture is not drawn from its own source, or a picture is drawn from a part of its source, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the tool is not there, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when PlantUML fails or writes no picture, or the skins of the themes do not carry the colours of the site, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes' is the same, the text says that the chain of the search lives in one place and that every picture is drawn from the whole of its own source, the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same as it was: the loop of the themes loses the dark one.  Twelve controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- seven by the writer of the wave and five more by the parent, and the parent's five were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 28 seconds.  (2) The sourcing line of the chain is gone and the comment that names the file is left (the control of the discriminator) -- «scripts/dev does not read scripts/lib/tools.sh: the pipeline does not use the chain of the search»; code 1.  (3) A copy of the body of the chain under a name of its own (`scripts/lib/tools-copy.sh') -- «the body of the chain of the search is copied in scripts/lib/tools-copy.sh: the chain lives in one place (scripts/lib/tools.sh) and not in two»; code 1.  (4) The source of the diagram is cut when the wrapper is built -- «the picture of alpha (light) does not carry the label second-of-alpha of its own source: the picture was drawn from a part of its source», and the same for the other three pictures; code 1.  (5) The control of the claim (the loop of the themes loses the dark one) -- «the pipeline drew [alpha-light.svg beta-light.svg state-machine-light.svg ] and not two pictures for every diagram»; code 1.  The false greens are measured and not asserted: the **old** check of `HEAD' answers with the code 0 on the copy of the body (3) and on the cut source (4), and with the code 1 on every control of the new check.  The writer measured one more thing and named it: the **literal** text of the control of the discriminator for F17 -- `"$src" | sed "/second-of-/d" >"$wrapper"` -- does not cut the source at all, because the shell reads `"$src"' as a command to run and not as a file to read; the check still falls there, but on the runtime and not on the content of the source.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 940 lines and 36.9 kB (the wave 83 one was 821 lines and 31.3 kB), and it goes in 28 seconds; the tree of the diagrams has one diagram, and the picture of it is drawn twice.
